title: nano-claw voice loop
one_liner: A local, voice-powered AI agent that runs in your browser with Metal-accelerated speech recognition and tool execution.
what_it_is: nano-claw is a personal AI assistant designed for local execution. It creates a continuous voice loop where users speak to their browser, audio is transcribed via Whisper (running natively on Mac for GPU speed), processed by Claude (via API), and spoken back using Kokoro TTS. It supports interactive tool approval, allowing the AI to request permission before executing shell commands or file operations on the host machine.
how_its_built: The system uses a hybrid architecture to bypass Docker GPU limitations on macOS. A native Python service runs `faster-whisper` on port 8200 using Apple Metal acceleration. The core logic, including the TypeScript API server and Python-based Voice Server (handling WebRTC and Kokoro TTS), runs inside a Docker container. The browser client communicates via WebSockets for real-time audio streaming and UI updates.
how_to_apply: Use this project as a foundation for building private, voice-first AI agents that require low-latency speech-to-text on Apple Silicon. It demonstrates how to bridge native high-performance ML services with containerized application logic and secure tool execution patterns.
features: Real-time voice interaction via WebRTC in the browser
Metal-accelerated Whisper STT running natively on macOS
Kokoro TTS for natural-sounding voice responses
Interactive tool approval for shell and file operations
Persistent conversation memory stored in JSON files
Modular skill system loaded from Markdown definitions
